items.text: Its alternative budget proposed no change to the public health insurance that covers everyone who works or lives legally in the country. The only health measure reported in it was replacing medical aid for undocumented migrants with emergency-only care.
Published an alternative budget proposing to end non-contributory benefits for foreigners who have not worked full-time for at least five years.
In the same alternative budget, proposed lifting a freeze on social benefits and returning the retirement age to 60 or 62.
